4.3.1 Capacity building, mentorship provided to CBS, VRRC, and other relevant government institutions and development partners

A two-day Durable Solutions Capacity Building Workshop was successfully conducted in Kassala State on 22–23 December 2025, bringing together 33 participants from government institutions, UN agencies, NGOs, and development partners, with 27% female representation. The workshop strengthened the capacity of state and national institutions to plan and implement Durable Solutions initiatives, contributing directly to improved coordination and technical understanding within the Area Solutions Working Group (ASWG)
Capacity building will be held to manage the KM hubs for ADSWG in November 2026.
